text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Should I head back soon, I 
wonder...?

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“—Our clearance sale will now begin on the 
1st floor! Please come on down to the 
special event area!”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whoa. It suddenly got so crowded. 
This is tough.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Could you let me through? It's 
a bit... umm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Caught up in a crowd she couldn't stand, 
Mr. C.B. was left utterly exhausted...
